scope: DEMO / LOCAL. Not a production deployment or a literature-priority claim.

environment.execution: in-process TS + local EVM (forge/anvil class); forge-std cloned to TEMP only

commitmentConstruction.formula: C_t = keccak256(abi.encode(bytes32 C, uint256 E_I, uint256 E_M, uint64 T_expiry, bytes32 N))
commitmentConstruction.acceptance: E_I == current E_I && E_M == current E_M && t <= T_expiry && N not consumed

scenarios.description: Settle with a cryptographically valid C_t after the identity key was revoked.
steps: Human signs C_t with E_I=1, E_M=1.
Authority revokes the identity key, advancing E_I to 2.
Settlement presents the unchanged C_t; the guard reads E_I=2 and rejects.

scenarios.description: Settle after the human mandate was revoked while the identity key is unchanged.
steps: Human signs C_t with E_I=1, E_M=1.
Authority revokes the mandate, advancing E_M to 2.
Settlement presents the unchanged C_t; the guard reads E_M=2 and rejects.

scenarios.description: Rotating the identity key invalidates a C_t signed under the old key.
steps: Human signs C_t under identity key K1 (E_I=1).
Authority rotates to K2 and advances E_I to 2 atomically.
The old C_t carries E_I=1 and can no longer satisfy the current-epoch guard.

scenarios.description: A cached epoch snapshot would accept; the execution-time read rejects.
steps: Guard caches {E_I=1, E_M=1} before the revocation.
Authority revokes the identity key (E_I=2).
Naive cached check would accept; the execution-time read rejects.

scenarios.description: Revocation lands between a passing pre-check and the settlement call.
steps: Pre-check passed (E_M=1, accepted=true).
Revocation is committed before settlement executes (E_M=2).
Execution-time check rejects; the rejected attempt does not consume N.

scenarios.description: A delayed message arrives after T_expiry even though no revocation occurred.
steps: Human signs C_t with T_expiry = 1_800_000_000.
Message is delivered at T_expiry + 1 second.
The inclusive expiry check rejects the delayed settlement.

scenarios.description: Replay of the same C_t after N was consumed by the honest settlement.
steps: First settlement accepted (accepted=true) and consumed N.
Attacker replays the identical C_t and payment nonce.
The single-use application nonce check rejects the replay.

scenarios.description: Positive control: current epochs, in-window time and unconsumed N.
steps: Human signs C_t with current E_I=1, E_M=1.
Settlement executes inside the validity window.
Guard accepts; the honest control is not falsely rejected.

revocationLatencyMs.meaning: in-process revokeIdentity + one acceptance decision; excludes network, consensus and RPC time

gasOverhead.source: forge test --match-contract RevocationAwareGuardTest -vv (TEMP forge-std remap, local EVM)
gasOverhead.baselineDefinition: same-shape accept that recomputes C_t, checks H(C_t) and writes one storage slot, without authority epoch reads or expiry checks
gasOverhead.caveat: delta also includes cold account access, ABI decode and the settlement event; LOCAL ANVIL / DEMO only
